# Teams SDK & Angular — Documentation Technique (offline)

> Offline edition combining the Teams SDK docs (C# .NET, TypeScript, Python) and the Angular docs
> (from https://microsoft.github.io/teams-sdk/llms_docs/llms_csharp.txt, llms_typescript.txt, llms_python.txt and https://angular.dev/llms.txt + full content).
> Every feature lives in its own file under `docs/<language>/<category>/`; all cross-references are relative links inside this repo — no external fetching needed.
